item.title: Contratto di ricerca: Synthesis of novel supramolecular catalysts for electrosynthesis (ROMA "Tor Vergata")
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-08 23:59
Institution: ROMA "Tor Vergata", Roma
Field: Chemistry / 03/CHEM-05 Chimica organica

The project focuses on the synthesis and characterization of novel supramolecular catalysts for electrosynthesis, with particular emphasis on controlling the selectivity of electrochemical processes. The research will involve the design and synthesis of new functional molecules, followed by structural and physicochemical characterization and the assessment of their electrocatalytic and supramolecular recognition properties. In particular, systems combining electron-transfer mediation with selective interactions towards substrates or reaction intermediates will be investigated to direct the course of electrochemical transformations. item.title: Contratto di ricerca: CR N. 1 ISOF BO_Study of Graphene-Based Composite Materials for Gas Purification (CNR - Istituto per la sintesi organica e la fotoreattività)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-05 18:00
Institution: CNR - Istituto per la sintesi organica e la fotoreattività, Bologna
Field: Chemistry / 03/CHEM-03 Chimica generale e inorganica

Production of 2D nanocomposite materials using solution-based deposition techniques and supramolecular chemistry, and their characterization using atomic force microscopy, X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy, quartz microbalance, and measurements of permeability and surface area. This research will provide expert scientific support for the validation of the experimental data obtained within the project, enabling their correct interpretation and effective use for the development and implementation of the NAMAC project.

item.title: Contratto di ricerca: Safety and nutritional assessment of novel proteins using advanced analytical techniques (Univ. PARMA)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-04 23:59
Institution: Univ. PARMA, Parma
Field: Chemistry / 03/CHEM-07 Chimica farmaceutica, tossicologica, nutraceutico-alimentare, delle fermentazioni e dei prodotti per il benessere e per la salute

the proposed research programme pursues two complementary objectives. First, it aims to develop an integrated analytical platform capable of comprehensively assessing both the safety and nutritional quality of innovative protein ingredients through the application of state-of-the-art analytical methodologies. Second, it seeks to implement a range of capacity-building and knowledge-transfer activities for researchers from the MENA region through blended learning, online education, and on-site training programmes, thereby strengthening scientific expertise and fostering long-term international collaboration
